title: Voglio e non vorrei.
html_source: “I want to and I wouldn’t like to.”

anchor.prefix:
rter looped round a stocking: rumpled, shiny sole. 

1961#63

 — No: that book. 

 Other stocking. Her petticoat. 

 — It must have fell down, she said. 

 He felt here and there.
anchor.suffix: Wonder if she pronounces that right: voglio. Not in the bed. Must have slid down. He stooped and lifted the valance. The book, fallen, sprawled against the bulge of the orangekeye
